g.title: ERD
g.text: DWAN Executive Cyber Risk Command Center — Consolidated Database ERD
PostgreSQL 15+ · 42 tables · generated from the executed schema · ★ new since 001+002 · PK primary key · FK foreign key · TK tenant key (org_id → organizations, RLS) · ·nn not null · ·gen generated
Edges to organizations (every tenant table) and users (owners, approvers) are shown as “→ table” on the column instead of as lines.
